comment:
* Generic state machine for handling messages and waiting for ordered broadcasts to complete.
 * Subclasses implement {@link #handleSmsMessage}, which returns true to transition into waiting
 * state, or false to remain in idle state. The wakelock is acquired on exit from idle state,
 * and is released a few seconds after returning to idle state, or immediately upon calling
 * {@link #quit}.

variables.name: EVENT_BROADCAST_COMPLETE
variables.comment: Result receiver called for current cell broadcast.

variables.name: EVENT_RELEASE_WAKE_LOCK
variables.comment: Release wakelock after a short timeout when returning to idle state.

variables.name: EVENT_BROADCAST_NOT_REQUIRED
variables.comment: Broadcast not required due to geo-fencing check

variables.name: WAKE_LOCK_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: Wakelock release delay when returning to idle state.

variables.name: mReceiver
variables.comment: * BroadcastReceiver to send message to return to idle state.

methods.name: public final void dispose()
methods.comment: * Tell the state machine to quit after processing all messages.

methods.name: public final void dispatchSmsMessage(Object obj)
methods.comment:
* Send a message with the specified object for {@link #handleSmsMessage}.
     * @param obj the object to pass in the msg.obj field

methods.name: protected abstract boolean handleSmsMessage(Message message)
